question: Someone you deeply trust betrays you. What is your first instinct?

options.text: Cut them off completely. Silence is the sharpest weapon.
Confront them immediately. You need answers now.
Study the situation first. There's always a deeper motive.
Forgive them. Everyone is fighting a battle you know nothing about.

question: You walk into a party where you know nobody. What do you do?

options.text: Own the room. You were born for moments like this.
Find one interesting person and have a real conversation.
Observe quietly. You learn more by watching than talking.
Stay close to whoever you came with. Loyalty over everything.

question: What does love mean to you?

options.text: An all-consuming force. When you love, it devours everything else.
Protection. You'd burn the world down for the people you love.
A partnership of equals. Balanced, strategic, mutual.
Power. Love is the strongest leverage there is.

question: You discover a close friend has been lying to you for months. You:

options.text: Disappear from their life without explanation.
Explode. You feel everything at full volume.
Ask yourself what you missed. What were the signs?
Try to understand why they felt they had to lie.
Intensity. When you care, there is nothing half-hearted about it.
Instinct. Your gut is almost never wrong.
Intelligence. You are always three steps ahead.
Resilience. You have survived things that would break others.

question: Someone challenges your authority in public. You:

options.text: Smile coldly. They've just made a very serious mistake.
Fire back immediately. Nobody disrespects you and walks away clean.
Stay calm. Reacting is losing. You'll handle it privately.
Genuinely try to hear them out. Maybe they have a point.

question: Your ideal Saturday night looks like:

options.text: Alone, deep in your thoughts, reading or creating something.
Out with your people, fully present, fully alive.
At an event where you can network, observe, and strategize.
Deep, uninterrupted one-on-one time with someone who matters.
Disappear. Nobody gets to see you fall apart.
Lash out. Pain turns to anger before you can stop it.
Analyse it. If you understand the pain, you can neutralise it.
Reach out. You believe in letting people in.

question: The most dangerous thing about you is:

options.text: Your patience. You will wait as long as it takes.
Your anger. Once triggered, there's no off switch.
Your mind. You see things others can't and use it.
Your love. You destroy yourself for the people you choose.

question: In a group, you naturally become:

options.text: The one everyone follows without knowing why.
The protector. You keep your people safe no matter the cost.
The strategist. The one with the plan when everything falls apart.
The heart. The emotional core that holds everyone together.

question: What do you want most from a relationship?

options.text: Complete devotion. All or nothing.
Someone who can keep up with your fire.
An intellectual equal. Someone who challenges your mind.
Stability and honesty. Someone real.
Obsessive. When you fixate on something, nothing else exists.
Destructive. You burn bridges before they burn you.
Manipulative. You know exactly which buttons to press.
Self-sacrificing to a fault. You hurt yourself to protect others.

question: If you could have one supernatural power, you'd choose:

options.text: Compulsion — the ability to make anyone do what you want.
Enhanced strength and speed — pure, raw power.
Premonition — the ability to see what's coming.
Empathic healing — the ability to feel and remove others' pain.

question: Your biggest fear in a relationship is:

options.text: Losing the one person who truly sees you.
Not being able to protect the ones you love.
Being outplayed by someone who knows you too well.
Being abandoned by the person you trusted most.

question: When making a hard decision, you trust:

options.text: Your heart. It has never truly been wrong.
Your instincts. The body knows before the mind does.
The data. Emotion is the enemy of good decisions.
The people around you. Wisdom lives in community.
